snippet.title: Pictionary: Game Night - Next Games, a Netflix Game Studio
snippet.description:
Are you ready to draw 'til you drop?
Introducing Pictionary: Game Night, available now on your smart TV’s Netflix app.
In this hilarious and fast-paced spin on Mattel’s classic group game, rather 'round the TV to guess what your friends are drawing.
